sections.text:
Return
Protection Scheme and Associated Equipment to Service

items:
Return relay
 to services by with drawing the test plug handle from the relay

Make sure C.T
 secondary are opened

Return relay
 to service by restoring supply from voltage transformer (V.T) miniature
 circuit breaker MCB`S is closed

Place the
 associated breaker failure (B.F) protection scheme back in service

Restore the
 previously blocked disturbance alarrns and fault recorder associated with
 this protection

Return the
 relay power line carrier (PLC) links to their normal position

Turn ON the
 associated auto - reclosure scheme

Turn ON the
 power supply DC to relay 7SL32

Take crossed
 readings of all AC currents and voltages supplied to the relay and compare
 them to those for normal load conditions.

Check that
 these readings agree with station meters:-
 MW , MVAR , power factor , Amperes , voltages

Place a copy
 of the test results in the field maintenance file, and test sheet
